long_biography.plain_text:
Stephen Orenstein's path into logistics began with an abrupt succession. Educated in New Hampshire and at Lehigh University, he returned to Frankfurt when his father died and took over Supreme Group in 1985. The family company had started by supplying American military bases in Germany. Under Orenstein, it expanded internationally; Afghanistan contracts for food and water became its decisive growth engine.

Frankfurt football formed a durable second thread. A season-ticket holder at Eintracht Frankfurt since 1985, Orenstein later invested through Freunde des Adlers and served on the club's supervisory board. That commitment joined capital with a Frankfurt connection sustained from the year he assumed responsibility for Supreme.
